{{Top|leg}}
A '''hallmaster''' in [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] society controlled large cavernous structures on [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree worlds]] known as "halls." Hallmasters were common within Gree society. [[Satikan]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Asation]], was controlled by about a dozen hallmasters.<ref name="The Gree Enclave">{{JournalCite|8|The Gree Enclave}}</ref>
